Architecture

Two layers. One card. Zero names.

Layer 1 · Offline Emergency
What a paramedic sees

Decoded offline by any MRS-credentialed scanner. No network. No delay. Available from the moment of scan — in an ambulance, in the field, before the hospital.

Structured UUID with demographic metadata
Blood type (ABO/Rh)
Active medications — drug code + dose
Active diagnoses — ICD-10, top 5 by severity
Known allergies
Attending physician — MRS credential code only
Last physician visit date & zone
Emergency contact flag
Layer 2 · Full Chart Pointer
What a physician sees

Requires active network and physician portal credential. Retrieves the complete longitudinal history from the MRS Engine — every visit, every lab, every protocol change.

Complete visit history — all enrolled physicians
Full lab results and progression timeline
Prior medication changes with dates
Active MRS research briefs on file
Emergency contact details
Cross-domain clinical flags from MRS Engine

Our Mission

The search
never ends.

Foundry One Sciences was built on a single premise: the most important medical breakthroughs don't come from isolated disciplines. They come from the space between them.

The MRS Engine systematically mines the intersections of oncology, cardiovascular science, neurology, and metabolic disease — surfacing drug hypotheses that conventional research silos miss.

From hypothesis to provisional patent to clinical intelligence product, every output from Foundry One Sciences carries the weight of a system designed to keep looking long after others have stopped.

A distributed medical think engine

The MRS Engine uses card game mechanics as a structural metaphor for how biological research is classified, compared, and cross-referenced. Each of the four disease domains corresponds to a suit — enabling systematic mining of cross-domain intersections that no single-discipline approach can replicate.

Outputs are classified through the JELLO insight framework, scored through the Reasonable Man Standard, and captured as drug hypotheses, formulation protocols, and clinical intelligence assets.

01
JELLO Classification Insight moments scored by biological depth (Red → Violet) and cross-domain source discipline
02
AAD Scanner v2.0 MeSH, SNOMED-CT, UMLS, Gene Ontology taxonomy layer with ETL-style pipeline staging
03
Reasonable Man Standard Human-judgment quality filter ensuring every hypothesis meets a defensible evidentiary threshold
04
Version-Controlled Discovery Logs Every hypothesis is timestamped, versioned, and preserved as intellectual property evidence
Product Portfolio

Four hypotheses.

Metabolic ♣
InsuLes™
Precision metabolic support for insulin sensitivity
A multi-pathway insulin-sensitivity formulation developed from MRS cross-domain analysis of metabolic pathway intersections. Full formulation details are available to physicians on request.
Provisional Patent Metabolic

Metabolic / GLP-1 ♣
Leapsin™
The GLP-1 step-down bridge
Positioned as a physician-supervised bridge therapy for patients transitioning off GLP-1 agonists. Leapsin™ supports weight maintenance and appetite regulation during the critical off-ramp period — addressing one of the fastest-growing unmet needs in metabolic medicine.
Provisional Patent GLP-1 Adjunct Highest NTM Value
↗
Ophthalmology / Immunology ♦
ZeaCyte™
Zeaxanthin + CD8 T cell modulation for AMD
A novel hypothesis connecting zeaxanthin's known macular protective properties to CD8 T cell immune modulation in age-related macular degeneration. Targets early/intermediate dry AMD and neovascular wet AMD through a dual-mechanism approach.
Provisional Patent Ophthalmology Immunomodulatory
↗
